items.text: Todd Bowles called WR Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot), S Antoine Winfield Jr. (rib) and RT Luke Goedeke (calf) questionable; all three missed Week 7. Wednesday/Thursday practice will decide. Baker Mayfield (thumb) came through his return.

Atlanta had no new injuries reported from the Week 7 win over San Francisco. RB Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring), LB Divine Deablo (forearm) and CB Billy Bowman Jr. (hamstring) were out in Week 7; no Week 8 update yet.
